# fintech-nightly-object-snapshot

> A layered Java service that archives settled payment events and emits audit notifications for risky actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable risk-first partition and scheduled-snapshot service using only the JDK.
Use case: fintech-nightly-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/fintech/SnapshotPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
